theme_and_vibe.name: High-Density Swiss Fintech (The 'Carta-Bloomberg' Hybrid)
theme_and_vibe.mode: Dark Theme (Mandatory for power-user financial tools to reduce eye strain)
theme_and_vibe.description: A clean, professional, finance-grade dashboard that prioritizes data density, clarity, and authority. It uses sharp edges, explicit grid borders, and a stark monochromatic base with highly intentional, sparse accent colors for momentum and actions. Avoids all 'bubbly' or 'soft' SaaS aesthetics.
theme_and_vibe.e1_twist: Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI is strictly grayscale (tinted slate). Accent colors are reserved exclusively for data momentum (positive/negative trends) and primary CTAs. Zero border-radius globally to enforce a rigid, mathematical feel.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant: Authoritative Display Headings + Highly legible Sans Body + Sterile Mono for all financial data.

headings.usage: Page titles, large structural headers, fund names.

body.usage: Standard UI text, descriptions, contact lists.

metrics_and_data.usage: All numerical data, investment amounts, valuations, dates, table cells.
metrics_and_data.rules: Keeps numbers tabular and vertically aligned.

hierarchy_rules.H1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tighter font-semibold (Kept smaller than marketing pages to maximize dashboard real estate)

grid_borders.concept: Expose the skeleton. Make the grid visible.
grid_borders.implementation: Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items use 'border-r border-b border-slate-800'. No floating cards with soft shadows.
grid_borders.usage: Data-heavy dashboard widgets, CRM tables, Portfolio metrics.

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, multi-tenant fund switcher bar.

spacing_and_layout.dashboard_density: Mode B: High Density Grid. Every pixel must be utilized. Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-px with grid background color).
spacing_and_layout.containers: Full-width dashboard layout. Avoid constrained max-width containers for data views. Use p-4 md:p-6 for main padding.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment for text and inputs. Right-alignment for numerical values in tables to allow decimal scanning.
spacing_and_layout.pipeline_board: Kanban style but highly condensed. Horizontal scrolling container, distinct vertical columns with sharp 1px borders.

key_views_strategy.multi_tenant_header: Global fixed top bar with a stark, brutalist dropdown (Shadcn Select) to switch between 'Beta Fund' and 'Fund I'. Always visible context.
key_views_strategy.portfolio_dashboard: Follow 'North Star' pattern. Top-left quadrant shows 'Deployed Capital'. First row is 4 key metrics (MOIC, IRR, Investments) using JetBrains Mono with Trend momentum indicators. Below: Sector breakdown chart and recent activity.
key_views_strategy.companies_pipeline: Dense tabular or board view. Emphasize 'Stage' with strict color-coded pills (sharp edges, uppercase).
key_views_strategy.company_detail: Progressive disclosure via Tabs (Overview, Conversations, Diligence, Investment, Contacts). Tabs must be sharp, border-bottom style, no pills. Left sidebar for static company info, main right area for the selected tab content.
key_views_strategy.diligence_checklist: Action-oriented. Use a rigid table layout with Shadcn checkboxes. Clear status indicators (Not Started, In Progress, Complete, Blocked).

components_customization.buttons: rounded-none, sharp edges. Use hover:-translate-y-[1px] transition-transform. Primary buttons use indigo-600.
components_customization.inputs_and_forms: rounded-none, bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500. Left aligned.
components_customization.tabs: Override Shadcn default pills. Use border-b-2 transparent data-[state=active]:border-indigo-500 data-[state=active]:text-slate-50 text-slate-400 bg-transparent rounded-none h-auto py-2.
components_customization.tables: Dense rows. py-2 px-3 cells. Hover state on rows: bg-slate-800/50. Header text: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500.
components_customization.badges: rounded-none border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 text-xs font-mono px-2 py-0.5.
components_customization.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn chart). Minimal axes, remove grid lines or make them very faint (slate-800). Monochromatic bars/lines with one accent color.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Minimalist and snappy. No bouncy animations.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out for buttons and rows. No 'transition-all'.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Tables rows must subtly highlight. Interactive elements must lighten on hover (e.g., bg-slate-900 to bg-slate-800). Text contrast must remain high.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use sharp linear progress bars at the top of the container, not circular spinners.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use 'Regular' or 'Light' weight for standard UI, 'Fill' for active states. Keep sizes consistent (16px or 20px). Do not use AI emojis.

auth_background.description: Contemporary building with futuristic design and geometric lines. Used for the Auth/Login screen background side-panel to convey structural integrity and finance.

empty_state_texture.description: Modern architectural facade with geometric patterns. Can be used as a very low opacity (10%) background image for empty states (e.g., 'No investments yet').

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
DO NOT use HTML-based components for interactions; explicitly use customized Shadcn UI components.
DO NOT apply 'transition-all' anywhere in the CSS.
DO NOT use pure black (#000) or pure white (#fff) for large surfaces. Use slate-950 and slate-50.
DO NOT use borders with rounded corners. Enforce rounded-none everywhere to match the brutalist finance style.
MUST use 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows) using kebab-case and role-based naming.
MUST ensure numerical data and tables use the monospace font 'JetBrains Mono'.
MUST explicitly set text color on hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-slate-50).
MUST place the fund context switcher prominently in a sticky header.
For global search, implement a cmdk/command menu (Shadcn Command) accessible via a keyboard shortcut.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs/headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap (except in dense data tables).
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
